## agent-ml-research
ML research experiment management tools

attachment.content:
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").
- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).
TRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.
SKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- review: Review a pull request
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

prompt_len\\nprint(f\\\"  generated={actual_gen}, using first {n_gen}\\\")\\n\\n# Dense forward WITH output_attentions\\nprint(\\\"\\\\n--- Dense forward (output_attentions=True) ---\\\")\\nattn_mask = torch.ones_like(full_ids).to(\\\"cuda\\\")\\nwith torch.no_grad():\\n    outputs = model(input_ids=full_ids, attention_mask=attn_mask, output_attentions=True)\\nlogits = outputs.logits[0]\\nlabels = full_ids[0]\\n\\nn_nan_logits = torch.isnan(logits).any(dim=-1).sum().item()\\nn_inf_logits = torch.isinf(logits).any(dim=-1).sum().item()\\nprint(f\\\"Logits: {n_nan_logits} NaN positions, {n_inf_logits} inf positions (of {logits.shape[0]})\\\")\\n\\n# CE WITHOUT .float()\\nce_fp16 = F.cross_entropy(logits[:-1], labels[1:], reduction=\\\"none\\\")\\nn_nan16 = torch.isnan(ce_fp16).sum().item()\\nn_inf16 = torch.isinf(ce_fp16).sum().item()\\nprint(f\\\"CE (no .float()): {n_nan16} NaN, {n_inf16} inf\\\")\\n\\n# CE WITH .float()\\nce_fp32 = F.cross_entropy(logits[:-1].float(), labels[1:], reduction=\\\"none\\\")\\nn_nan32 = torch.isnan(ce_fp32).sum().item()\\nn_inf32 = torch.isinf(ce_fp32).sum().item()\\nprint(f\\\"CE (.float()):     {n_nan32} NaN, {n_inf32} inf\\\")\\n\\nif n_nan16 > 0 or n_nan_logits > 0:\\n    print(\\\"\\\\n*** NaN DETECTED ***\\\")\\n    if n_nan_logits > 0:\\n        nan_pos = torch.where(torch.isnan(logits).any(dim=-1))[0].cpu().tolist()\\n        print(f\\\"NaN logit positions (first 30): {nan_pos[:30]}\\\")\\n    if n_nan16 > 0:\\n        nan_ce_pos = torch.where(torch.isnan(ce_fp16))[0].cpu().tolist()\\n        print(f\\\"NaN CE(fp16) positions (first 30): {nan_ce_pos[:30]}\\\")\\n    \\n    # Map to phases\\n    offset = 0\\n    for pname, psize in zip(phase_names, phase_sizes):\\n        phase_start_ce = prompt_len + offset - import json
import numpy as np
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F

with open(prof_path) as f:

ppi = list(prof["per_problem_ii"].values())[0]
diag = prof["diagnostics"]["per_problem_sparsity"]

# Find target: always missing low, has valid high
target_idx = None
for p in ppi:
    if p.get("ii_low") is None and p.get("ii_high") is not None:
        target_idx = p["problem_idx"]
        target_id = p["problem_id"]
        break

print(f"Target: [{target_idx}] {target_id}")

phase_names = td["phase_names"]
phase_sizes = td["phase_sizes"]
n_gen = td["n_tokens"]
print(f"  gen_tokens={n_gen}, phases={len(phase_names)}")

# Load model
model_path = prof["config"]["model"]
print(f"\nLoading model from {model_path}...")

tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_path, trust_remote_code=True)

    trust_remote_code=True, attn_implementation="eager"
)
model.eval()

# Load data - match by problem_id
with open("/root/autodl-tmp/pacs/data/math500.json") as f:
    all_data = json.load(f)
if isinstance(all_data, dict) and "data" in all_data:
    all_data = all_data["data"]

item = None
for d in all_data:

    if uid == target_id or target_id.endswith(uid) or uid.endswith(target_id):
        item = d
        break
if item is None:
    # try partial match
    short = target_id.replace("test/", "").replace(".json", "")
    for d in all_data:
        if short in str(d):
            item = d
            break

if item is None:
    print("ERROR: Could not find problem in data file")
    print(f"  Looking for: {target_id}")
    print(f"  First few data IDs: {[d.get('unique_id', d.get('id', ''))[:50] for d in all_data[:3]]}")
    import sys; sys.exit(1)

problem_text = item.get("problem", item.get("question", ""))
prompt_ids = tokenizer(problem_text, return_tensors="pt").input_ids
prompt_len = prompt_ids.shape[1]
print(f"  prompt_len={prompt_len}")

# Generate
print(f"Generating...")
with torch.no_grad():
    gen_out = model.generate(
        prompt_ids.to("cuda"), max_new_tokens=min(2048, n_gen + 50),
        do_sample=False, temperature=1.0
    )
full_ids = gen_out[:, :prompt_len + n_gen]
actual_gen = full_ids.shape[1] - prompt_len
print(f"  generated={actual_gen}, using first {n_gen}")

# Dense forward WITH output_attentions
print("\n--- Dense forward (output_attentions=True) ---")
attn_mask = torch.ones_like(full_ids).to("cuda")
with torch.no_grad():
    outputs = model(input_ids=full_ids, attention_mask=attn_mask, output_attentions=True)
logits = outputs.logits[0]
labels = full_ids[0]

n_nan_logits = torch.isnan(logits).any(dim=-1).sum().item()
n_inf_logits = torch.isinf(logits).any(dim=-1).sum().item()
print(f"Logits: {n_nan_logits} NaN positions, {n_inf_logits} inf positions (of {logits.shape[0]})")

# CE WITHOUT .float()
ce_fp16 = F.cross_entropy(logits[:-1], labels[1:], reduction="none")
n_nan16 = torch.isnan(ce_fp16).sum().item()
n_inf16 = torch.isinf(ce_fp16).sum().item()
print(f"CE (no .float()): {n_nan16} NaN, {n_inf16} inf")

# CE WITH .float()
ce_fp32 = F.cross_entropy(logits[:-1].float(), labels[1:], reduction="none")
n_nan32 = torch.isnan(ce_fp32).sum().item()
n_inf32 = torch.isinf(ce_fp32).sum().item()
print(f"CE (.float()):     {n_nan32} NaN, {n_inf32} inf")

if n_nan16 > 0 or n_nan_logits > 0:
    print("\n*** NaN DETECTED ***")
    if n_nan_logits > 0:
        nan_pos = torch.where(torch.isnan(logits).any(dim=-1))[0].cpu().tolist()
        print(f"NaN logit positions (first 30): {nan_pos[:30]}")
    if n_nan16 > 0:
        nan_ce_pos = torch.where(torch.isnan(ce_fp16))[0].cpu().tolist()
        print(f"NaN CE(fp16) positions (first 30): {nan_ce_pos[:30]}")
    
    # Map to phases
    offset = 0
    for pname, psize in zip(phase_names, phase_sizes):
        phase_start_ce = prompt_len + offset - 1  # CE index
        phase_end_ce = prompt_len + offset + psize - 1
        if n_nan16 > 0:
            n_in = sum(1 for p in nan_ce_pos if phase_start_ce <= p < phase_end_ce)
        elif n_nan_logits > 0:
            n_in = sum(1 for p in nan_pos if prompt_len + offset <= p < prompt_len + offset + psize)
        else:
            n_in = 0
        if n_in > 0:
            print(f"  Phase {pname:15s} [{offset:4d}:{offset+psize:4d}]: {n_in} NaN")
        offset += psize
else:
    print("\n*** NO NaN in logits or CE ***")
    print("Issue must be elsewhere. Checking ppl_from_cached_losses behavior...")
    
    # Simulate ppl_from_cached_losses for each phase
    seq_len = full_ids.shape[1]
    offset = 0
    for pi, (pname, psize) in enumerate(zip(phase_names, phase_sizes)):
        token_indices = list(range(prompt_len + offset, prompt_len + offset + psize))
        idx = torch.tensor([i - 1 for i in token_indices if 0 < i < seq_len], device=ce_fp16.device)
        if idx.numel() == 0:
            ppl_val = float("nan")
            reason = "empty idx"
        else:
            selected = ce_fp16[idx]
            n_nan_sel = torch.isnan(selected).sum().item()
            n_inf_sel = torch.isinf(selected).sum().item()
            ppl_val = torch.exp(selected.mean()).item()
            reason = f"nan={n_nan_sel} inf={n_inf_sel} ppl={ppl_val:.4f}"
        if pi < 5 or pname == "low_sparsity":
            print(f"  Phase {pi:2d} {pname:15s} [{offset:4d}:{offset+psize:4d}] tokens={len(token_indices)} idx={idx.numel()} {reason}")
        offset += psize

# Check attention NaN
nan_layers = []
for l in range(len(outputs.attentions)):
    if torch.isnan(outputs.attentions[l]).any():
        nan_layers.append(l)
print(f"\nNaN attention layers: {nan_layers if nan_layers else 'none'}")

# Dense forward WITHOUT output_attentions
print("\n--- Dense forward (output_attentions=False) ---")
with torch.no_grad():
    outputs2 = model(input_ids=full_ids, attention_mask=attn_mask)
logits2 = outputs2.logits[0]
n_nan2 = torch.isnan(logits2).any(dim=-1).sum().item()
ce2 = F.cross_entropy(logits2[:-1], labels[1:], reduction="none")
n_nan_ce2 = torch.isnan(ce2).sum().item()
print(f"Logits: {n_nan2} NaN, CE(no .float()): {n_nan_ce2} NaN")

print("\n=== DONE ===")

import json, torch
import torch.nn.functional as F

prof_path = "/root/autodl-tmp/pacs/profiling_output_v6_importance_s015/profiling_results.json"

diag = prof["diagnostics"]["per_problem_sparsity"]
target_idx = 1  # prealgebra/192
target_id = ppi[target_idx]["problem_id"]
td = diag[target_idx]

model_path = prof["config"]["model"]

from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_path, trust_remote_code=True)
if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
    tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token

# Test 1: bf16
print("=== TEST 1: bf16 ===")
model_bf16 = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
    model_path, torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16, device_map="cuda",
    trust_remote_code=True, attn_implementation="eager"
)
model_bf16.eval()

with open("/root/autodl-tmp/pacs/data/math500.json") as f:
    all_data = json.load(f)
if isinstance(all_data, dict) and "data" in all_data:
    all_data = all_data["data"]
item = None
for d in all_data:
    uid = d.get("unique_id", d.get("id", ""))
    if target_id.endswith(uid.replace(".json","")) or uid == target_id:
        item = d
        break
if item is None:
    for d in all_data:
        if "192" in str(d.get("unique_id", "")):
            item = d
            break

problem_text = item.get("problem", item.get("question", ""))
prompt_ids = tokenizer(problem_text, return_tensors="pt").input_ids
prompt_len = prompt_ids.shape[1]

with torch.no_grad():
    gen_out = model_bf16.generate(prompt_ids.to("cuda"), max_new_tokens=850, do_sample=False)
full_ids = gen_out[:, :prompt_len + td["n_tokens"]]

attn_mask = torch.ones_like(full_ids).to("cuda")
with torch.no_grad():
    out_bf16 = model_bf16(input_ids=full_ids, attention_mask=attn_mask, output_attentions=True)

logits_bf16 = out_bf16.logits[0]
n_nan_bf16 = torch.isnan(logits_bf16).any(dim=-1).sum().item()
ce_bf16 = F.cross_entropy(logits_bf16[:-1].float(), full_ids[0, 1:], reduction="none")
n_nan_ce_bf16 = torch.isnan(ce_bf16).sum().item()
print(f"  Logits NaN: {n_nan_bf16}/{logits_bf16.shape[0]}")
print(f"  CE NaN: {n_nan_ce_bf16}/{ce_bf16.shape[0]}")

nan_attn = [l for l in range(len(out_bf16.attentions)) if torch.isnan(out_bf16.attentions[l]).any()]
print(f"  NaN attention layers: {nan_attn if nan_attn else 'none'}")

del model_bf16, out_bf16
torch.cuda.empty_cache()

# Test 2: fp16 with NaN filtering - recovery potential
print("\n=== TEST 2: fp16 NaN-filtered PPL recovery ===")
model_fp16 = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
    model_path, torch_dtype=torch.float16, device_map="cuda",
    trust_remote_code=True, attn_implementation="eager"
)
model_fp16.eval()

with torch.no_grad():
    gen_out2 = model_fp16.generate(prompt_ids.to("cuda"), max_new_tokens=850, do_sample=False)
full_ids2 = gen_out2[:, :prompt_len + td["n_tokens"]]
attn_mask2 = torch.ones_like(full_ids2).to("cuda")

with torch.no_grad():
    out_fp16 = model_fp16(input_ids=full_ids2, attention_mask=attn_mask2, output_attentions=True)
logits_fp16 = out_fp16.logits[0]
labels = full_ids2[0]
ce_fp16 = F.cross_entropy(logits_fp16[:-1].float(), labels[1:], reduction="none")

# Check how many segments can be recovered with NaN filtering
phase_names = td["phase_names"]
phase_sizes = td["phase_sizes"]
seq_len = full_ids2.shape[1]

print(f"\nPhase-by-phase NaN impact (total NaN CE: {torch.isnan(ce_fp16).sum().item()}):")
offset = 0
for pi, (pname, psize) in enumerate(zip(phase_names, phase_sizes)):
    token_indices = list(range(prompt_len + offset, prompt_len + offset + psize))
    idx = torch.tensor([i - 1 for i in token_indices if 0 < i < seq_len], device=ce_fp16.device)
    if idx.numel() == 0:
        offset += psize
        continue
    selected = ce_fp16[idx]
    n_nan = torch.isnan(selected).sum().item()
    n_total = selected.numel()
    
    # Current behavior: if any NaN, ppl = NaN
    ppl_current = torch.exp(selected.mean()).item()
    
    # NaN-filtered behavior
    valid = selected[~torch.isnan(selected)]
    if valid.numel() > 0:
        ppl_filtered = torch.exp(valid.mean()).item()
        frac_valid = valid.numel() / n_total
    else:
        ppl_filtered = float("nan")
        frac_valid = 0
    
    status = "RECOVERED" if n_nan > 0 and valid.numel() > 0 else ("OK" if n_nan == 0 else "LOST")
    print(f"  [{pi:2d}] {pname:15s} [{offset:4d}:{offset+psize:4d}] "
          f"nan={n_nan:2d}/{n_total:3d} ({100*n_nan/n_total:5.1f}%) "
          f"ppl={ppl_current:8.2f} -> {ppl_filtered:8.2f} "
          f"valid_frac={frac_valid:.3f} {status}")
    offset += psize

del model_fp16
torch.cuda.empty_cache()
print("\n=== DONE ===")
